decisions.title: Sticky mobile WhatsApp order bar
decisions.detail: At 375px add a fixed bottom bar with one primary CTA 'Agiza kwa WhatsApp' (height ≥48px, accent #E11D48 as a primary CTA button, Inter, sentence case) that opens wa.me with the product name; hidden at ≥768px where the card buttons are visible.

decisions.title: P-05
decisions.detail: Strict Grid Implementation: Enforce 4-column layout at 1280px (A3) using `grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr))` to fix the current 5-column error.
